root_grade.meṅ: 6.1.45 gives ā in the relevant non-śit environment. The class-one śit present has mayate.
root_grade.māṅ: The class-three present reduplication is tied to ślu. The lexical root teaching already has long ā in the future constructions.
root_grade.outside_present: Both have mātā, māsyate and māsīṣṭa. Kṣīrasvāmin expressly explains the absence of ī in the optative blessing māsīṣṭa by lack of kit in this middle form.

periphrastic_future: 2.4.85 gives the same third-person number substitutes for either pada. The second singular mātāse is a middle-specific control. The alternation of these two cells concerns endings.
semantic_context: The conditional still requires its licensed condition (3.3.139ff); the two preverb histories retain different lexical interpretations even when the full surface coincides.
independence: The commentary cites the bare forms and the preceding packet anchors full prefixed presents. The futures, blessings and conditionals below are writings, not individual textual attestations.
